event: First pre-nullus witness copy filed into incoming queue

witness_copy.description: Full internal system record of PR #38 (J-21 / Lumenar) — three parts: contributor submission, system response sequence, editorial notes on assembly. Carries custody header: suit ♦️ Diamond, plank Germ (3 facets — Recognition/Contribution/Acceptance), motion state WITNESSED, vault candidacy proposed. `.md` is the canonical seed (decided 202606191051); the `.docx` is retained as the original source artifact.

showpiece.description: Contributor-facing carrier (Spade of Jack) sent separately as a PR #38 comment — not filed in repo, not vault candidate. See prima-clock registry for send event.

notes: This is the first time the incoming-queue convention (custos/incoming/pre-nullus/) is used. Since the pre-nullus event originated inside custos itself, intake is custos receiving from itself — a degenerate but valid case that establishes the pattern for future repos.

format_decision.rationale: Raised by eaprime1 on PR #40: is .docx the right format, or should .md be the seed? Decision: .md is canonical for all witness/vault documents going forward — diffable, renders natively on GitHub, consistent with the rest of the repo (CLAUDE.md frames custos as a content/structure repo with no build pipeline, content elsewhere is exclusively .md/.yaml/.json). Binary originals (.docx, etc.) are retained alongside as source artifacts, not superseded, but not the seed.
format_decision.applies_to: incoming/pre-nullus/202606181903_PR38_pre-nullus-witness.md (this filing) and all future witness/vault intake
